# UDreamPanelLayoutBase

<!-- Generated by the DreamGUIReferenceDocs commandlet from reflection. Edit the header, not this page. -->

Inherits from `UDreamLayoutContainer`.

Declared in `Public/Core/Components/DreamPanelLayouts.h`.

Dream Panel Layout Base

## Functions

| Function | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `UDreamPanelSlot* AddChild(UDreamWidget* InChild, int32 InSiblingIndex)` | callable | Returns the child's slot, or null -- see UDreamWidget::AddChild for what null can mean. |
| `void DestroyAllChildren()` | callable | UMG's ClearChildren under the name this plugin already gave it: UMG merely detaches and lets GC take the pieces, which here would leave live registered widgets with nobody holding them. |
| `TArray<UDreamWidget*> GetAllChildren()` | pure | Get All Children |
| `UDreamWidget* GetChildAt(int32 InIndex)` | pure | Get Child At |
| `int32 GetChildIndex(UDreamWidget* InChild)` | pure | Get Child Index |
| `int32 GetChildrenCount()` | pure | UMG's UPanelWidget child API, forwarded to the widget that owns this container. |
| `bool HasAnyChildren()` | pure | Has Any Children |
| `bool HasChild(UDreamWidget* InChild)` | pure | Has Child |
| `bool RemoveChild(UDreamWidget* InChild)` | callable | Remove Child |
| `bool RemoveChildAt(int32 InIndex)` | callable | Remove Child At |
| `bool ReplaceChildAt(int32 InIndex, UDreamWidget* InContent)` | callable | UOverlay::ReplaceOverlayChildAt and UStackBox::ReplaceStackBoxChildAt, once, for every panel. |
| `void RequestLayoutRefresh()` | callable | Request Layout Refresh |

## Compared with UMG

Every Blueprint-facing member of the UMG class, and where it went. *adopt*: same name, same meaning. *map*: here under another name or on another type. *reject*: deliberately absent, with the reason.

| UMG | Member | Status | Here | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `UPanelWidget` | `GetChildrenCount` | adopt | `GetChildrenCount` | The whole family forwards to the widget that owns the container: the hierarchy belongs to UDreamWidget, and a second child list on the panel would be the one thing guaranteed to disagree with it. |
| `UPanelWidget` | `GetChildAt` | adopt | `GetChildAt` |  |
| `UPanelWidget` | `GetAllChildren` | adopt | `GetAllChildren` |  |
| `UPanelWidget` | `GetChildIndex` | adopt | `GetChildIndex` |  |
| `UPanelWidget` | `HasChild` | adopt | `HasChild` |  |
| `UPanelWidget` | `RemoveChildAt` | adopt | `RemoveChildAt` |  |
| `UPanelWidget` | `AddChild` | adopt | `AddChild` | Returns the slot. UMG needs a typed AddChildTo<Panel> per panel because each panel has its own slot class; there is one UDreamPanelSlot here, so there is one verb. |
| `UPanelWidget` | `RemoveChild` | adopt | `RemoveChild` | Detaches and leaves the child alive, as UMG's does; ownership passes to the caller. |
| `UPanelWidget` | `HasAnyChildren` | adopt | `HasAnyChildren` |  |
| `UPanelWidget` | `ClearChildren` | map | `DestroyAllChildren` | Named for what it has to do here. UMG's merely detaches and lets GC take the pieces, which in this plugin would leave live registered widgets with nobody holding them. |
